proposal: art-to-runtime integration proposal (not a skin.json schema change)
shell_dependency: scaffold12 heavier-housing candidate shell (renders/dark_moss_assets/component/dma_shell_full_assets_x4_1280x720.png as exported by scaffold12); NOT valid over the accepted scaffold09 shell

pressed.pixels_sha256_note: SHA-256 of the decoded RGBA8 pixels (row-major, top row first); stable across PNG re-encoding
pressed.relationship: 1:1 canvas pixels; sprite pixel (0,0) = canvas (149,644); draw unscaled
pressed.alpha: straight RGBA8, binary coverage (0 or 255): every pixel the button covers is opaque, edge colours are pre-blended against this shell's rail; no partial alpha
pressed.blend: standard source-over; with binary alpha this equals a masked copy (no premultiplication sensitivity)
pressed.replaces_idle: replaces the idle button's own pixel footprint (incl. its anti-aliased edge) exactly; idle shell stays loaded underneath. Valid only for the scaffold12 heavier-housing candidate shell export (not the accepted scaffold09 shell); re-render with the shell if the rail/chassis art changes

focused.role: optional art candidate (load only if HUD Runtime authorizes it)
focused.pixels_sha256_note: SHA-256 of the decoded RGBA8 pixels (row-major, top row first); stable across PNG re-encoding
focused.alpha: straight RGBA8, binary coverage (0/255), edge colours pre-blended against this shell
focused.replaces_idle: replaces the idle button's pixel footprint exactly; optional art candidate: do not assume it is loaded

state_semantics.pressed: momentary activation (not a persistent selected state); runtime owns timing
state_semantics.focused: energized, not pressed (face at rest height)

fallback: if a state file is missing or fails to load, draw nothing for that state: the shell's baked idle button is complete underneath
content_safe_interior_px: face area 158.6,653,92.4x33.2 (heavier housing) left clear: no text, no icons baked

source.pipeline: asset_render.render (Cycles 160 spp, 4x supersample, compositor dark_moss_balanced, premultiplied box reduction, straight sRGB8)
